data_hash: sha256 of the data sets as lines joined by \n, one per set: `id kind|item;item;...`. Sampled kinds: `time:value,value`, each value the 8 lowercase hex digits of its f32 bits or `-` for null. Intervals: `start:end:label:score`; words: `start:end:text:speaker`; absent fields are empty, a score is its f32 bits.
